long_description:
Free family-friendly yoga at Bonnie Wenk Park! Join YogaSix Oct. 25, 5–6 p.m., near the outdoor gym. Bring a mat and water.

About this Event

Join YogaSix for a complimentary hour of movement, fresh air, and community at Bonnie Wenk Park! Come on your own, bring a friend, or make it a family outing. This relaxed, playful class offers an approachable way to enjoy yoga together, with no previous experience needed.
We’ll incorporate simple movements and a casual flow that makes room for fun and connection. Children are welcome if they can follow along with guided instructions and participate alongside their family.
Event Details
Date: Sunday, October 25, 2026Time: 5–6 p.m.Location: Bonnie Wenk Park, 2996 Virginia Parkway, McKinney, TX 75071Meeting spot: Look for the YogaSix team near the outdoor gym space.Cost: Complimentary and open to the communityWhat to bring: A yoga mat and water are required.Bring your mat, bring your people, and enjoy an evening of yoga in the park!
